title: OpenAPI Events — event
description: One event, authored at data/<year>/<slug>/event.yaml. Hydrated by src/lib/events.ts, which resolves every speaker slug against the registry and derives startDate/endDate from event_date. Unknown keys are rejected: a mistyped field would otherwise be silently dropped at build time.

title.description: Display name, e.g. "API Days New York 2026".

slug.description: Must equal the containing folder name — src/lib/speakers.ts looks up per-event speaker overrides by that folder name, and scripts/sync-covers.mjs publishes the event's cover under it.

event_date.description: Display date AND the machine-readable source for the countdown. isoStartDate()/isoEndDate() in src/lib/events.ts parse it, so a shape outside this pattern silently loses the live NOW/finished behaviour. Month names must be capitalised English.

location.description: Venue and city, e.g. "Convene, 360 Madison Avenue, New York".

type.description: Free-text kind badge. Every event currently says "Event".

status.description: Authored lifecycle hint. `finished` always wins over the dates (so a cancelled event cannot come back to life); `active` pins this card to the featured slot. Otherwise the live phase is derived from the visitor's clock — see src/lib/eventPhase.ts.

image.description: Card artwork, as a path served from public/. When the event has a cover at data/<year>/<slug>/images/cover*, this must name its published path (/img/events/<slug>/cover.<ext>); scripts/sync-covers.mjs fails the build if the two disagree. Events without a cover point at any other served image.

time_start.description: Opening time on the first day. Defaults to 09:00 when absent.

time_end.description: Closing time on the last day. Defaults to end of day (23:59:59) when absent, which is what every event currently uses.

startDate.description: Escape hatch: overrides the value derived from event_date. Normally omitted.

endDate.description: Escape hatch: overrides the value derived from event_date + time_end. Normally omitted.

description.description: Prose blurb shown on the event page.

speakers.description: Headline speakers for the card and the event page. Each entry must exist in data/speakers/speakers.yaml or this event's speakers/speakers.yaml — an unknown slug throws at build time.

agenda.description: Programme, keyed by display date ("May 14", "December 6/7") and then by track name ("OpenAPI Track", "Workshops"). Both levels are free-form strings, rendered verbatim as headings.

talks.description: Full abstracts, one per talk page. A session finds its talk by the last segment of its permalink, which must match a talk's slug.

clockTime.description: 24-hour wall clock. Anything else is ignored and the default is used.

localDateTime.description: Local (not UTC) ISO datetime — no trailing Z or offset.

imagePath.description: Site-absolute path under public/, or a full URL.

speakerRef.description: A speaker slug, or {slug, tag} when this appearance needs an extra badge that is not part of the speaker's identity.
speakerRef.$comment: if/then rather than oneOf so a mistake reports against the shape actually written ("unknown property tags") instead of a branch mismatch ("must be string").

tag.description: Session-level badge, uppercased on render and appended after the speaker's own badges.

speaker.description: Single-speaker shorthand. Ignored when `speakers` is also present, so use one or the other.

time.description: Display time. A range is split on the dash for the talk page's start/end labels.

date.description: Per-session date override. Rarely needed — the agenda key already carries the day.

permalink.description: Links the session to its talk. The last segment must match a `talks[].slug` in this file, otherwise the agenda modal shows no abstract.

slidesUrl.description: Full URL, or a path relative to the site root.

slug.description: Becomes /events/talks/<slug>. Conventionally prefixed with the event slug to stay unique across events.

description.description: Abstract. Also surfaced in the agenda modal for the linked session.

category.description: Track name — normally the same key this talk's session sits under in `agenda`.

schedule.description: Optional timeline pills shown under the talk card.
